title: Have to / Don't have to / Needn't
summary: Use have to for necessary actions and don't have to or needn't when something is not necessary.

explanation.en: Have to expresses necessity. Don't have to and needn't mean there is no necessity.
explanation.ru: Have to выражает необходимость. Don't have to и needn't означают, что делать что-то необязательно.

examples.en: I have to get up early.
You don't have to bring food.

commonMistakes.note: Use has to with he, she and it.

commonMistakes.wrong: You don't have to smoke here.
commonMistakes.note: Use mustn't for prohibition, not don't have to.
